# ner-gold-generator — NER gold JSONL pipeline (marfago-labs)

> Build benchmark gold with deterministic offsets. Upstream of ner-dataset and ner-detector.

## Start here

- docs/README.md — documentation index
- docs/for-agents.md — offline/LLM tasks, schema links
- docs/portfolio.md — portfolio brief (upstream)
- README.md — quick start, technical highlights

## Contracts

- docs/configuration.md — `.env`, API keys (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `LLM_GOLD_MODEL`)
- docs/gold-schema.md — JSONL fields and invariants
- configs/synthetic_reference.yaml — annotated synthetic config (all options)
- configs/arxiv_benchmark.yaml — manual arXiv benchmark

## Offline smoke gold

uv sync --extra dev
uv run build-gold --source synthetic --synthetic-config configs/synthetic_smoke.yaml --output /tmp/synthetic_smoke.jsonl

## Sibling repos

- https://github.com/marfago-labs/ner-dataset — artifact store (llms.txt)
- https://github.com/marfago-labs/ner-detector — benchmarks (llms.txt)
